structured_output.hypothesis: In segmented plant tissue (Arabidopsis ovule), wall junctions where three cells meet have inter-wall angles near 120° irrespective of the size of the cells involved, with cell-size differences showing up in wall curvature rather than in the angles.
structured_output.pass_criterion: Using 2D cross-sections (e.g. orthogonal slices) of the segmented cell label stacks in the wild-type high-quality ovule set (158 ovules), at least 1,000 triple junctions (three-cell vertices, sampled across at least 20 ovules) are measured. Each junction angle is measured from the tangent directions of the three walls within 1 µm of the vertex. PASS requires all of: (a) median of the three angles per junction within 120° ± 5°; (b) at least 80% of junctions with all three angles in 120° ± 20°; (c) absolute Spearman correlation between the junction's angle deviation (max |θ−120°|) and the log size ratio of the largest to smallest of the three cells below 0.15; (d) a positive Spearman correlation of at least 0.3 between wall curvature and the log size ratio of its two flanking cells.
structured_output.fail_criterion: FAIL if any of the following: median junction angle lies outside 120° ± 10°; fewer than 60% of junctions have all angles in 120° ± 20°; or the absolute Spearman correlation between angle deviation and log cell-size ratio is 0.3 or more. Results in between are inconclusive. The test is also inconclusive if fewer than 1,000 usable junctions can be extracted.
structured_output.interpretation: Thompson's 'cell-walls meeting by threes' means a line where three cell interfaces meet, seen as a vertex in a 2D section. 'Angle' is the angle between the tangents of the three walls at that vertex. 'Size of cell' is the cell's section area, or 3D volume, from the label image. 'Curvature of partition-walls' is the local curvature of the shared interface between two cells. Modern reinterpretation: the dataset is 3D confocal imaging of Arabidopsis ovules, segmented by PlantSeg, not a 1917-style parenchyma section. Angles are therefore measured in 2D sections or as dihedral angles between mesh faces along triple edges. Four-way junctions are expected to be rare and are excluded. Ovule tissues are younger and more actively growing than mature parenchyma. Segmentation errors add noise, so only the high-quality dataset is used.

dataset.why_it_fits: It is a public cell-resolution 3D atlas of a plant tissue. It has 158 high-quality wild-type ovules with segmented cell label stacks, which give cell volumes and cell-cell contacts, so junction angles and wall curvature can be measured against cell size. Fields used: segmentation label images (High-quality_dataset.zip), plus the cell-attribute CSV files and 3D cell meshes described in the associated eLife paper. The record gives HTTP, FTP and Globus download links.
